title: GWMME — Google Workspace Migration for Microsoft Exchange — Implementation
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Google Workspace migration/architecture).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity and the Microsoft/Entra side authored at exact detail from the vendors' public docs. Third-party and Google-native MIGRATION TOOLS (Google Workspace Migrate, GWMME, BitTitan MigrationWiz, CloudM) are covered at the procedural playbook level — deep tool-console internals, licensing, and support are deferred to each vendor's own documentation, never invented; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify for your version'. Gemini features flagged 'verify in your tenant'. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
hook: Migrate Exchange mail to Gmail with GWMME the right way
problem: For mail-focused moves, Google Workspace Migration for Microsoft Exchange (GWMME) pulls mail, calendar, and contacts from Exchange/M365 into Gmail — but it needs the right service account, permissions, and batching. This solution is the GWMME implementation playbook: install and configure GWMME, grant the required Exchange/M365 access, build a mapping/CSV, run batched migrations with throttling awareness, and validate mail/calendar/contacts — so mailbox data lands complete.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — what GWMME migrates (mail/calendar/contacts), where it fits vs Workspace Migrate and third-party tools, and its batch model.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (GWMME host, Exchange/M365 access + service account, Google access, mapping data, pilot scope).

Implementation Guide — install/configure GWMME, grant access, build the mapping/CSV, run a pilot batch, validate, then scale batches — pilot-first; tool internals deferred to Google's GWMME docs, procedure and sequencing given.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (pilot mailboxes complete, calendar/contacts intact, errors triaged) plus Best Practices for reliable batch execution.
short: Implement GWMME for Exchange→Gmail migration — install/configure, grant access, build mappings, run batched throttled migrations, and validate mail/calendar/contacts — so mailbox data lands complete. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
